mapper.select: SELECT PRS_ID, OTP_ENABLED_YN, OTP_SECRET_ENC, PENDING_SECRET_ENC, PENDING_EXPIRES, FAIL_COUNT, LOCKED_UNTIL, LAST_VERIFIED_DATE, LAST_USED_STEP, ENROLLED_DATE, UPDATED_DATE, IFNULL(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, NOW(), LOCKED_UNTIL), 0) AS LOCK_REMAIN_SEC, (PENDING_SECRET_ENC IS NOT NULL AND PENDING_EXPIRES IS NOT NULL AND PENDING_EXPIRES > NOW()) AS PENDING_VALID FROM WH_ADMIN_MFA WHERE PRS_ID = #{prsId}
mapper.update: INSERT INTO WH_ADMIN_MFA (PRS_ID, OTP_ENABLED_YN, PENDING_SECRET_ENC, PENDING_EXPIRES, FAIL_COUNT, UPDATED_DATE) VALUES (#{PRS_ID}, 'N', #{PENDING_SECRET_ENC}, DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL #{minutes} MINUTE), 0, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE PENDING_SECRET_ENC = VALUES(PENDING_SECRET_ENC), PENDING_EXPIRES = VALUES(PENDING_EXPIRES), UPDATED_DATE = NOW()

UPDATE WH_ADMIN_MFA SET OTP_SECRET_ENC = #{OTP_SECRET_ENC}, OTP_ENABLED_YN = 'Y', PENDING_SECRET_ENC = NULL, PENDING_EXPIRES = NULL, FAIL_COUNT = 0, LOCKED_UNTIL = NULL, LAST_USED_STEP = #{LAST_USED_STEP}, ENROLLED_DATE = NOW(), LAST_VERIFIED_DATE = NOW(), UPDATED_DATE = NOW() WHERE PRS_ID = #{PRS_ID}

UPDATE WH_ADMIN_MFA SET FAIL_COUNT = #{FAIL_COUNT},
LOCKED_UNTIL = DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL #{lockMinutes} MINUTE),
LOCKED_UNTIL = LOCKED_UNTIL,
UPDATED_DATE = NOW() WHERE PRS_ID = #{PRS_ID}

UPDATE WH_ADMIN_MFA SET FAIL_COUNT = 0, LOCKED_UNTIL = NULL, LAST_VERIFIED_DATE = NOW(), LAST_USED_STEP = IFNULL(#{LAST_USED_STEP, jdbcType=BIGINT}, LAST_USED_STEP), UPDATED_DATE = NOW() WHERE PRS_ID = #{PRS_ID}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO WH_ADMIN_MFA_BACKUP_CODE (PRS_ID, CODE_HASH, USED_YN, CREATED_DATE) VALUES (#{PRS_ID}, #{CODE_HASH}, 'N', NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT CODE_ID, CODE_HASH FROM WH_ADMIN_MFA_BACKUP_CODE WHERE PRS_ID = #{prsId} AND USED_YN = 'N'
mapper.update: UPDATE WH_ADMIN_MFA_BACKUP_CODE SET USED_YN = 'Y', USED_DATE = NOW() WHERE CODE_ID = #{CODE_ID} AND USED_YN = 'N'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM WH_ADMIN_MFA_BACKUP_CODE WHERE PRS_ID = #{prsId} AND USED_YN = 'N'

SELECT P.PRS_ID, P.PRS_NAME, P.PRS_AUTH, P.PRS_COUNTRY, P.PRS_USE_YN, IFNULL(M.OTP_ENABLED_YN, 'N') AS OTP_ENABLED_YN, M.ENROLLED_DATE, M.LAST_VERIFIED_DATE, M.FAIL_COUNT, IFNULL(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, NOW(), M.LOCKED_UNTIL), 0) AS LOCK_REMAIN_SEC, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM WH_ADMIN_MFA_BACKUP_CODE B WHERE B.PRS_ID = P.PRS_ID AND B.USED_YN = 'N') AS BACKUP_LEFT FROM WH_PRESS P LEFT JOIN WH_ADMIN_MFA M ON M.PRS_ID = P.PRS_ID WHERE P.PRS_AUTH IN ('SM', 'LC') ORDER BY FIELD(P.PRS_AUTH, 'SM', 'LC'), P.PRS_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO WH_ADMIN_AUDIT_LOG (PRS_ID, EVENT_TYPE, RESULT, REASON_CODE, TARGET_ID, CLIENT_IP, USER_AGENT, DETAIL, CREATED_DATE) VALUES (#{PRS_ID, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{EVENT_TYPE}, #{RESULT}, #{REASON_CODE, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{TARGET_ID, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{CLIENT_IP, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{USER_AGENT, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{DETAIL, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NOW())
mapper.select:
SELECT LOG_ID, PRS_ID, EVENT_TYPE, RESULT, REASON_CODE, TARGET_ID, CLIENT_IP, USER_AGENT, DETAIL, CREATED_DATE FROM WH_ADMIN_AUDIT_LOG
ORDER BY LOG_ID DESC LIMIT #{start}, #{length}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM WH_ADMIN_AUDIT_LOG WHERE EVENT_TYPE = #{eventType} AND RESULT = 'F' AND CREATED_DATE >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{minutes} MINUTE)
